rows.note: Use 以前 as the all-purpose choice for something happening at an earlier time.

example.english: I previously ate here all the time.
example.traditional: 我以前成日喺呢度食飯。
example.jyutping: ngo5 ji5 cin4 seng4 jat6 hai2 ni1 dou6 sik6 faan6

rows.note: Use 之前 when the earlier time is understood relative to another event or reference point.

example.english: Had you previously been to this shop?
example.traditional: 你之前有冇去過呢間舖頭？
example.jyutping: nei5 zi1 cin4 jau5 mou5 heoi3 gwo3 ni1 gaan1 pou3 tau4

rows.note: Use 舊時 specifically when referring to the old days or a much earlier period.

example.english: People previously didn't have so many choices.
example.jyutping: gau6 si4 di1 jan4 mou5 gam3 do1 syun2 zaak6
